heroHeadline: Day 972: Haredi Rioters Attack Supreme Court Justice's Home Amid October 7 Accountability Countdown — 26 Days to July 1 Deadline; Hamas Qassam Brigades Without Commander for 10th Day
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. June 5, 2026 (Day 972 / Ceasefire Day 239): A wave of Haredi extremist violence against Israel's judicial institutions has intersected with the October 7 accountability countdown in an unprecedented constitutional crisis. On the night of June 3–4, dozens of ultra-Orthodox rioters attacked the home of Supreme Court Deputy President Noam Sohlberg in Alon Shvut, smashing windows, destroying his car, and planting a swastika-marked Israeli flag — while Sohlberg and his wife were inside. 62 suspects arrested. Supreme Court President Isaac Amit called it 'a pogrom' and 'an attack on the rule of law.' Netanyahu issued his 'strongest condemnation.' The same Supreme Court targeted by the mob is scheduled to rule in 26 days — by July 1, 2026 — on whether the Netanyahu government has established a credible October 7 investigation framework. The coalition's Kallner inquiry bill remains three plenum readings short of passage with early elections looming; 63–72% of Israelis (JPPI/Hebrew University polling) support an independent commission. June 2 (Day 969): Al-Qassam Brigades Abu Obeida vowed 'assassinations will never break resistance' — Hamas's command vacuum entered Day 7 with no new Qassam Brigades supreme commander named since Odeh's killing (May 27). June 3 (Day 970): Trump's Board of Peace 'stalled out' on Gaza reconstruction (WaPo) — less than $1B of $17B pledged received; IDF Chief Zamir declared 'no ceasefire for our forces' in Lebanon; Hamas warned of 'heavy price' for ceasefire violations. June 4 (Day 971): Netanyahu condemned Haredi attack on Sohlberg's home; Supreme Court President Amit called it 'a pogrom'; constitutional crisis deepens with 27 days to July 1. As of Day 972 (June 5): Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades remain without named supreme commander for 10 consecutive days; Imad Aqel is last surviving senior October 7 architect and NILI's primary target; 3,005+ ceasefire violations; 857+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire began October 10, 2025. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
